events.title: Build v0.99.9
events.summary: Multiplayer is out of beta and in the regular build! Up to four octopuses in one store. Most of you are seeing it for the first time, so here is what it is and how to play together, as well as the smaller fixes since 0.99.3. The full game launches Tuesday, so please tell me in the Discord if anything breaks!MultiplayerOne of you hosts their store and up to three friends join it. Physics costs are shared between players. But, like most games, you should always host on the strongest machine.Points

events.title: Build v0.99.3 - Performance boost for lower graphics tiers
events.summary: Performancethe Easygoing, Comfortable and Steam Deck graphics presets now use half resolution textures, which saves a lot of memory on 4 GB cards. Rich still uses full resolutionturned off a few rendering features the game never used, so the GPU has less to doFixesfixed a missing character in one of the Chinese tutorial linesHave fun! -alex

events.title: Build v0.99.2 - Motion sickness mode and Checkout area!
events.summary: By request, this patch adds a motion sickness mode based on the one PowerWash Simulator uses. I did a lot of research on this, and there's no universal fix for motion sickness, so let me know how it feels if you try it. I'm hoping that between this and the other accessibility options, you can find something that's comfy for you!The checkout counter also got rebuilt, thanks to my friend who has been grinding on it while I focus on other parts of the game. (Thank you Marie for all the help!)Motion
